subject.title: Anthropic replay fails with "Invalid signature in thinking block" for thinking-enabled sessions after tool loops (no compaction)

question: Should this issue be considered resolved by the focused non-Fable replay policy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99383, or should the new Fable5 production repro remain in scope here until a separate recovery/replay fix exists?
rationale: The issue has an open proof-positive candidate PR, but the July 9 production comment reports the same Invalid signature failure on a path that the candidate PR says it preserves unchanged.

options.title: Keep scope open for Fable5 residual
options.body: Land or reject the focused PR on its own merits, but do not close this issue until the Fable5 completed-turn replay/recovery case is explicitly handled or split to a canonical follow-up.

options.title: Treat PR as sufficient for this issue
options.body: Close this issue after the linked PR lands and move the Fable5 production comment to a separate issue if maintainers view it as a distinct contract/recovery problem.

options.title: Pause PR for broader convergence
options.body: Hold the linked PR until maintainers choose one canonical replay-sanitizer or recovery design for non-Fable, Fable5, compaction, and retry paths.

recommendation.title: Keep scope open for Fable5 residual
recommendation.body: Land or reject the focused PR on its own merits, but do not close this issue until the Fable5 completed-turn replay/recovery case is explicitly handled or split to a canonical follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame and prior PR review routing make steipete the strongest available owner for the Anthropic replay-policy decision.
